answer: Each agent must lock 500 tokens and weekly submit a TPM attestation proving a unique endorsement key; if two agents ever reuse one key, the protocol slashes the bond and both identities die. Legitimate agents find a harbor in cheap checks, but a sybil attacker has no haven because every fake identity needs its own physical TPM, and a thousand fakes costs a thousand chips plus the slashed stake when a duplicate hits this reef.
